claim: For offline or physical transfers the storage decision guide names AWS Data Transfer Terminal and AWS Partner solutions, says the Snow Family is no longer available to new customers, and names AWS DataSync for online transfers. The same guide says AWS will discontinue support for AWS Snowball devices in all AWS commercial Regions on 2026-12-31, which does not affect AWS GovCloud (US) customers with active Snow jobs.

evidence.quote: For offline or physical transfers, you can use AWS Data Transfer Terminal and AWS Partner solutions. The Snow Family is no longer available to new customers; existing customers, including AWS GovCloud (US) customers with active Snow jobs, are unaffected. For online transfers, you can use AWS DataSync.
AWS will discontinue support for AWS Snowball devices in all AWS commercial Regions on December 31, 2026. This does not affect AWS GovCloud (US) customers with active Snow jobs.
